definitions.directional_attribution: Long and short results are trade attribution within the joint account; they are not independent direction-only drawdowns.
definitions.profit_factor: Gross winning net P&L divided by absolute gross losing net P&L after all recorded costs; undefined when there are no losses.
definitions.losing_streak: Consecutive net-loss trades in time order; a zero-P&L trade breaks the streak.
definitions.mfe_mae: Raw price points from entry through minutes before a regular exit; the period_end close-minute high/low is included. Costs are excluded.
definitions.minute_drawdown: Joint-account close mark-to-market drawdown includes the initial capital as a high-water mark; unrecovered episodes are censored at the final minute.
definitions.period_returns: Calendar year/month end-of-trading-day equity returns; the first period is measured from standardized initial capital.
